meta.title: AI Memory Vault
meta.description: Long-term memory as an Obsidian vault: every conversation becomes linked notes plus a user profile. /load injects it, /write archives the window, /update builds the graph, /zip compresses, /new rebuilds from history.

settings.vaultPathHint: Absolute path, or ~/path. Empty = $DSH_HOME/ai-memory. Open this folder in Obsidian to browse the graph.
settings.modelHint: provider/model. Empty = follow the session's current model.
settings.includeToolDigest: Include tool names and file paths in the digest
